column1: How every character reacts to each gift, sorted the same way as the Lookup: seen in game, then other sources the model agrees with, then the model's prediction from confirmed tags, then its guesses from suspected tags, then sources it can't check. The number in brackets is the Support the gift gives that character at Support 1, out of 120. Click a gift to jump to it, or use Ctrl+F to find a character. Birthday gifts are left out.
